question: By which name is the historical road built by Sher Shah Suri known?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grand trunk road**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sher Shah Suri**, a king of the **16th century**, constructed the **Grand Trunk Road**.
 
• It was referred to as "**Sadak e Azam**."
 
• The road was essential for inland trade since it connected **India to Central Asia.**
 
• This street's previous names include **Uttarapath, Badshahi Sarak, and Sarak e Azam**.
 
• The longest and oldest significant road in Asia.
 
• **3,710 kilometers **make up this road's length.
 
• The west end of this route is in** Kabul, Afghanistan**, and the east end is in **Teknaf, Bangladesh**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sher Shah Suri**

 
 
• **Sher Shah Suri (1472, or 1486 - 22 May 1545)**, born **Farid Khan,** was the founder of the **Sur Empire in India**, with its capital in** Sasaram** in modern-day **Bihar**.
 
• He reduced the weight of silver coins to 178 grams and gave the money the Sanskrit name rupee, which is an ancient synonym for silver.
 
• In the year** 1540 CE, Sher Shah **seized power over the** Mughal Empire**. His son** Islam Shah** succeeded him after his untimely death in** 1545 CE. **
